title: Front End Developer
full_description_html:
Key Responsibilities

  • Develop responsive and interactive user interfaces using React.js, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Build reusable, scalable, and maintainable React components following modern frontend development practices.
  • Work with React Hooks such as useState, useEffect, useContext, and custom hooks.
  • Convert UI/UX designs, wireframes, and prototypes into functional and responsive web pages.
  • Integrate REST APIs and connect frontend applications with Node.js and other backend services.
  • Work with API requests, asynchronous JavaScript, JSON data, and error handling.
  • Implement frontend routing and navigation using React Router.
  • Manage application state using React Context API, Redux, or other state management solutions.
  • Create responsive layouts compatible with desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
  • Optimize website performance, page loading speed, and frontend rendering.
  • Follow clean coding practices and maintain reusable component architecture.
  • Debug frontend issues, fix UI bugs, and improve application functionality.
  • Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, and product teams to deliver new features.
  • Use Git and GitHub for version control, code collaboration, and project management.
  • Participate in code reviews, team discussions, daily standups, and Agile development activities.
  • Write basic unit tests and ensure the reliability and functionality of frontend components.
  • Follow web accessibility, cross-browser compatibility, and modern frontend development standards.
  • Research and explore emerging frontend technologies, libraries, and AI-powered development tools.

Technical Skills Required

Candidates should have a good understanding of the following technologies:

Frontend Development

  • HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
  • React.js fundamentals and component-based architecture.
  • React Functional Components and React Hooks.
  • Props, State Management, and Component Lifecycle.
  • React Router and frontend navigation.
  • Responsive Web Design and CSS Flexbox/Grid.
  • API integration using Fetch API or Axios.
  • JSON, asynchronous programming, Promises, and Async/Await.

Development Tools

  • Basic knowledge of Git and GitHub.
  • Familiarity with VS Code or other code editors.
  • Understanding of browser developer tools and debugging.
  • Basic knowledge of npm and package management.
  • Familiarity with Postman or similar API testing tools.

Bonus Skills (Good to Have)

  • Knowledge of Next.js and server-side rendering.
  • Familiarity with TypeScript.
  • Understanding of Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or other state management libraries.
  • Experience with Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, Material UI, or Ant Design.
  • Basic knowledge of Node.js and Express.js.
  • Understanding of REST API architecture and JWT authentication.
  • Familiarity with Firebase or other backend-as-a-service platforms.
  • Knowledge of website SEO fundamentals, Core Web Vitals, and performance optimization.
  • Exposure to AI-powered coding assistants and AI-integrated frontend applications.
  • Familiarity with Vercel, Netlify, Docker, or basic CI/CD workflows.

Soft Skills

  • Strong logical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Passion for frontend development and learning new technologies.
  • Good understanding of programming fundamentals.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to writing clean code.
  • Good communication and time management skills.
  • Willingness to learn, experiment, and adapt to new technologies.
  • Ability to take ownership of assigned tasks and meet deadlines.

Eligibility Criteria

  • B.Tech / B.E. / BCA / MCA / B.Sc. (Computer Science / IT) or equivalent educational background.
  • Students, freshers, and recent graduates interested in frontend development can apply.
  • Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React.js is preferred.
  • Candidates with personal projects, academic projects, GitHub repositories, or a frontend development portfolio will have an added advantage.
  • A strong willingness to learn React.js and modern web development technologies is essential.

What You Will Learn

  • Practical experience in React.js frontend development.
  • Building real-world responsive web applications.
  • Developing reusable React components and frontend architectures.
  • Integrating REST APIs with frontend applications.
  • Working with Git, GitHub, and collaborative development workflows.
  • Understanding real-world software development and Agile methodologies.
  • Debugging, testing, and optimizing production-oriented web applications.
  • Exposure to modern frontend technologies and AI-assisted development workflows.

Who Should Apply?

This internship is suitable for aspiring React.js developers, frontend developer freshers, computer science students, and recent graduates who want to gain hands-on industry experience and build a career in frontend engineering.

If you are passionate about JavaScript, React.js, modern UI development, and building impactful web applications, we encourage you to apply.

Start your journey as a Frontend Developer and gain practical experience building modern web applications with React.js.

title: AI Engineer Internship

We are looking for an AI Engineer Intern to build intelligent systems, AI-powered workflows, and scalable data infrastructure that power next-generation AI products.

You will work on integrating and evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs), building automated data pipelines, developing AI-powered information extraction systems, and creating intelligent search and discovery capabilities. Depending on the product requirements, your work may involve model APIs, embeddings, retrieval systems, web crawling, structured data extraction, and AI agents.

Inspired by modern AI infrastructure platforms such as OpenRouter, you will gain practical experience working with multiple AI models, designing reliable LLM workflows, measuring model performance, and building systems that move beyond experimental notebooks into production applications.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys Python, applied AI, backend engineering, and solving complex technical problems with measurable outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Develop systems to discover, organize, and enrich information about AI models, tools, APIs, datasets, research papers, benchmarks, and emerging technologies.
  • Implement embedding generation, semantic search, vector retrieval, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
  • Build and maintain data processing pipelines, validation rules, deduplication, and entity resolution.
  • Experiment with model selection, prompt engineering, structured outputs, and tool calling.
  • Design evaluation pipelines to measure model accuracy, relevance, latency, reliability, and cost.
  • Implement robust error handling, retries, rate-limit management, caching, and fallback strategies for AI API integrations.
  • Develop backend services and APIs that expose AI-powered capabilities to frontend applications.
  • Monitor pipeline quality, investigate failures, and improve data freshness and system reliability.
  • Research new models, AI frameworks, and infrastructure tools to identify practical improvements.
  • Document experiments, technical decisions, and performance benchmarks.

Requirements

  • Strong proficiency in Python and solid programming fundamentals.
  • Understanding of APIs, JSON, HTTP, asynchronous programming, and backend development.
  • Hands-on experience building at least one meaningful project using an LLM API or open-source language model.
  • Understanding of LLM fundamentals, prompt engineering, tokens, context windows, and structured outputs.
  • Familiarity with data processing, web scraping, and data ingestion using tools such as Requests, BeautifulSoup, Playwright, or Scrapy.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, SQLite, MongoDB, or another database.
  • Familiarity with Git and GitHub.
  • Understanding of data structures, algorithms, debugging, and writing maintainable code.
  • Ability to evaluate technical approaches through experiments rather than relying solely on model outputs or assumptions.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • A portfolio of AI projects, GitHub repositories, research implementations, or working demos that demonstrate practical engineering ability.

Good to Have

  • Experience with OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or other LLM APIs.
  • Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face Transformers, or agent frameworks.

  • Familiarity with MCP, function calling, multi-agent systems, or tool-use workflows.

Strong Python fundamentals, practical project experience, and the ability to explain your technical decisions are more important than having used every framework listed above.

Moonshot Factory Inc. is hiring for AI Product Reviewer/Beta-Testing Intern (Full-Stack AI Engineering)

About the Company

Moonshot Factory is an AI-native engineering firm. Our engineers and AI agents work directly with teams to build, test and run AI and software products, from idea to operation. Through Moonshot Factory Studio we also build our own products. One of them, an AI agent observability platform, currently in stealth mode, launches publicly in November.

About the internship

We’re selecting a small group of student engineers to review and test that platform hard before launch. You’ll connect it to an AI app or agent you have built or can built, use it as a real team would, and tell us exactly what’s broken, confusing or missing.

What you’ll do

  • Connect the product to your own AI project (agent, chatbot, RAG app, LLM tool) and send real usage through it

  • Suggest improvements from a product point of view, not just a technical one
  • Join short calls with the founder and use office hours when you need help

Who we’re looking for

  • Students who have built and deployed at least one AI project that uses an LLM, ideally one that’s live or used by someone
  • Comfortable with full-stack work and AI coding tools
  • A product mindset: you notice why something is frustrating, not just that it broke
  • Clear written communication in English
  • Your own laptop and a reliable internet connection
  • Available for clarification calls in at least one of these windows when needed:
    • 4:30–7:30 pm IST
    • 10:30 pm–12:00 am IST

What you get

  • Hands-on experience with a real, full-lifecycle AI SaaS product before its public launch
  • Direct mentorship from the founder
  • Cash rewards for the best testers: ₹15,000 for the top tester and about ₹8,000 each for the next four, judged on the quality and impact of findings, not the number filed

Selection process

title: AI Filmmaking Internship

We're hiring two AI filmmaking interns.

Most AI content studios want prompt engineers. We want storytellers: people who can read a vague brief and already picture the whole film before anything gets generated.

Mango Giraffe Labs is an early-stage company researching video and image models to make better films. We're also building a platform that makes filmmaking as easy as 1-2-3, and we work with real clients, including some of the biggest production houses in India. Right now we're working on one of the largest AI filmmaking projects coming out of the country this year, and you'd be on it.

The founding team is a mix of AI/ML researchers, platform builders and filmmakers. You'll work directly with them, including the CEO and CTO.

You're probably a good fit if:

  • You've made something you're proud of. A short film, a reel, a brand video, anything.
  • You have taste and strong opinions on aesthetics, composition and storytelling.
  • You can understand what a director wants and turn it into visuals.
  • You've used AI image and video tools enough to know what they can and can't do.
  • You want to own the whole creative process, from the first brief to the final frame.

Tools you should know:

  • DaVinci Resolve
  • Premiere Pro
  • Photoshop
  • AI video generation platforms
  • General video editing

Blender or 3D modelling experience is a bonus.

What you get:

  • A paid internship, starting at ₹10,000 a month
  • Direct access to the founders
  • Hands-on work on a real production with the latest AI filmmaking tools
  • Time with some of the people leading AI filmmaking right now
  • A project that will mean something on your CV

This is a high-ownership role, so you won't be stuck on busywork.

Location: Bangalore (preferred) or remote.

AI filmmaking is still being figured out, and the people who learn it now will help decide what it looks like.

Before you apply:

  • This is an internship, not a full-time job. Is that what you're looking for?

full_description_html:
About Us:

Dezainahub is one of the leading IT firms in Delhi-NCR, building for brands that hate looking small. We work with growth-focused businesses to build stronger brands, digital experiences, and technology solutions. We bring together Branding, UI/UX, Websites, Apps, Web Applications, Digital Products, Content, and Custom Technology Solutions to help businesses present themselves better, communicate clearly, and grow effectively.

  • PPO: 3.6 LPA-6 LPA
  • Role: Graphic Design Intern
  • Duration: 3-6 months + PPO
  • PPO: 3.6 LPA-6 LPA
  • Work Mode: Full-Time, On-Site
  • Location: Saket, New Delhi
  • Stipend: ₹5,000 - ₹10,000 / month
  • Eligibility: Graduates & Final-Year Students

About the Role

We are looking for a Graphic Designer Intern who wants to go beyond simply making things look pretty and focus on clean layout compositions, modern typography, proper spacing, hierarchy, and visual balance. You will work on real client projects, build digital and print marketing assets, and experiment with brand guidelines across multiple visual treatments. You must be curious enough to figure things out, step outside your comfort zone, accept feedback openly, and test different directions. This is a full-time, in-office internship. Applicants should be fully committed to working from our Saket office throughout the internship period.

What You'll Work On:

  • Digital Creatives: Create graphics for social media platforms, digital campaigns, banners, and marketing promotions.
  • Brand Assets: Develop brand-related visual assets and build presentations that align with guidelines.
  • Concept Exploration: Turn existing concepts into strong visual stories while exploring different design directions.
  • Visual Testing: Experiment with various layouts, compositions, typography, imagery, and visual styles to create multiple variations.
  • Design Support: Assist the creative team with daily visual requirements, explore new design trends, and work on unique project styles.           
  • Feedback Iteration: Actively take creative feedback to refine, edit, and improve designs through multiple versions.

What We Are Looking For:

  • Educational Background: Currently pursuing a degree/diploma in Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts (or a related field)—or simply genuinely passionate about design.
  • Core Design Instinct: A good eye for composition, typography, spacing, hierarchy, and visual balance.
  • Mindset & Ownership: Ability to take constructive feedback without taking it personally, work independently once given clear goals, and stay highly disciplined.
  • Tools & Skills: Practical experience with design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, Canva, or similar creative platforms.

We Especially Welcome People Who.

Love to experiment! If your reaction to "We've never tried this before" is "Let's try it," rather than "That's not how we were taught," you will fit right in. We value individuals who create beyond their comfort zone, test rather than assume, explore rather than copy, and take immediate initiative instead of waiting for micro-instructions.

What You'll Get:

  • Live Project Exposure: Real-world experience working on active client work and internal agency projects.
  • Professional Growth: Direct mentoring from an experienced creative team and exposure to the business side of design.
  • Executive Collaboration: Opportunity to work closely with the founding team and build a highly competitive portfolio.
  • Credentials: Certificate of Completion and a performance-based Letter of Recommendation (LOR).

full_description_html:
About Dr.CURA+

Dr.CURA+ is a new clinical skincare brand built for Indian skin and Indian weather. We start with the problems people have most, like acne, oily skin and dark spots, and solve them with simple regimes backed by real proof instead of hype. We're getting ready to launch on Amazon, Nykaa, Flipkart, Blinkit and Zepto. You'll help build the brand's social presence from day zero.

What you'll do

  • Plan and run Instagram, YouTube Shorts and LinkedIn: build the content calendar and handle posting, captions and hashtags.

Final-year students or fresh grads (2025/2026), any stream. Mass Comm, Marketing, Design or Life Sciences preferred. Must be available full-time, in-office in Gurugram, for 6 months starting immediately.

What you get

  • A certificate and letter of recommendation.
  • Free product, and real campaigns for your portfolio.

full_description_html:
Roles

  • Product Market Fit & Growth Intern, working directly with the founder and the sales team
  • About 80% of the role is product market fit research: learning our AI products and finding out which industries and companies need them most

Cross-functional work (20%)
